figurative_meaning_en: In various ways, with much pleading and entreaty
example_sentences_in_bangla: কত করে বললাম, তবু সে শুনল না।
কত করে অনুরোধ করলাম, কিন্তু সে রাজি হল না কিছুতেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I told him in so many ways, but he still wouldn't listen.
I pleaded with him repeatedly, yet he refused outright.
note: This idiom reflects the expressive nature of Bengali oral traditions in emphasizing persistence in communication.
